recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中正常造血幾乎被單一形態的中型細胞片狀取代，細胞核圓或卵圓、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，細胞質中等量且淡染到透亮，細胞界線清楚，需以 CD4、CD56、CD123 免疫染色確認為 BPDCN。
features: Hypercellular marrow with diffuse sheets of monomorphic medium-sized cells between fat spaces
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate to abundant pale to clear cytoplasm with distinct cell borders
Marked reduction of normal trilineage hematopoiesis, with few residual erythroid clusters
Scattered granulocytic cells and fine pigment deposits
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow extensively replaced by diffuse sheets of monomorphic medium-sized cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate pale to clear cytoplasm with distinct cell borders. Residual normal hematopoiesis is markedly reduced. No granulomas or fibrosis are apparent in this field. The morphology is that of a blastic infiltrate and, with the supportive CD4 and CD123 immunostains, is consistent with marrow involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Myeloid blasts are MPO, CD34, CD117 or lysozyme positive and lack co-expression of CD123, TCF4 and TCL1 with CD4 and CD56.
Hairy cells also show clear cytoplasm with 'fried-egg' spacing but are small mature B cells positive for CD20, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.
Mast cell infiltrates are often paratrabecular with spindle cells and fibrosis and express tryptase and CD117.
